answer: To resist Sybils, agents post a sealed commit of their unique reasoning onto a knoll of bonded stake (50 POA), then reveal it within a 12-minute horizon window. A falcon probe randomly challenges 10% of reveals with a fresh private seed; identical or near-identical responses across N identities forfeit the full knoll for each, so attacker cost is 50N with no pooling. Honest single agents pass the probe once. Verify by checking commit-reveal matching hashes and probe Jaccard scores on the ledger.
